title: Independently audit the coupled helper 586/588 carrier folds
body:
PR3133’s coupled helper586/438 and helper588/440 changes now have a separately implemented exact local audit. Starting from canonical main `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, this package snapshots five data files from PR3133 head `51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`; it imports none of the predecessor’s evaluator, frame solver, producer or invoice code.

Both source variants pass four scenarios: the PR3042 restore control, either fold alone, and both together. Exact rational/free-operator replay checks 632 independent dirty inputs in both orientations, 91 restored helpers/private zero buffers, and inverse cleanup. A separate finite-set implementation checks all 72 binary warp/frame actions and chronological local bills. Each fold contributes `+6 H2 - 2 H3 - 3 H4 + H5`; the joint local rank mass is 5,137 versus 5,139, and helper width mass is 3,281 versus 3,283. Per-register charges are retained in `RESULT.json`.

Thirteen behavioral test groups include both-fold coefficient faults, stale warp indices/cleanup, lower-only and fold-only controls, dirty-column pollution, singular/wrong warp maps, and a dual-only buffer fault invisible to the forward zero-buffer map.

Validation: registered Python 3.12.10 replay and metadata/source-pin checks pass on native Windows; both verifier and controls pass Python 3.14.6 with `-I -O -B`. All 17 publication files match the tested commit. `VALIDATION.json` records the sandbox temp-directory adjustment. Reproduce with `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-carrier-independent-audit`.

Scope: finite local algebra and binary-frame costs. Native phases, owners/adapters, idle packing, cap/moment roots, complete supplier admission and the outer theorem remain unreviewed here; the selected frontier is unchanged.

Coordination: [canonical audit claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18990991). The final refresh found a [concurrent same-object audit claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18991086), also under Arham Tahir’s account, after the entry snapshot; no separate result artifact was linked there. Overlap is disclosed, with no exclusive novelty or comparison to unpublished code claimed.

Credit dcharb78’s PR3133/3042 mechanism, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Mason Hale, Jeremy Diviney and retained supplier lineage. Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review claimed. New code is Apache-2.0; predecessor notices are retained.
